title: Add support for managing Wi-Fi P2P (Direct) and mesh connections
line: Wi-Fi P2P (Direct) connections can now be created and edited in the Wi-Fi & Networking settings, and Wi-Fi mesh connections keep their Mesh mode.
explanation: NetworkManagerQt already reads Wi-Fi P2P connections, but the connection editor had no case for them: they got the wired icon, no Wi-Fi P2P or IPv6 tab, and pressing Apply sent the connection without its wifi-p2p peer and IPv6 settings, which breaks it. Wi-Fi mesh is a mode of a normal Wi-Fi connection, and NetworkManagerQt's WirelessSetting had no mesh value, so the editor showed and saved such connections as Infrastructure. NetworkManagerQt gets a Mesh wireless mode; plasma-nm gets a Wi-Fi P2P tab with the peer MAC address (keeping any Wi-Fi Display data), the IPv6 tab, a Wi-Fi icon and name for P2P connections, a "Wi-Fi P2P (Direct)" entry in the new-connection list (autoconnect off), and a Mesh entry in the Wi-Fi Mode menu.

commits.message:
WirelessSetting: add the mesh mode

WirelessSetting only knew the infrastructure, ad-hoc and access point
modes, so an 802.11s mesh connection was read as infrastructure and was
saved back that way. Add a Mesh mode that maps to NetworkManager's mesh.

BUG: 502159

editor: support Wi-Fi P2P connections and the Wi-Fi mesh mode

Wi-Fi P2P connections had a wired icon and no settings, and saving one
dropped its peer and IPv6 settings, while mesh connections showed up as
Infrastructure. Add a Wi-Fi P2P type with a peer tab, and a Mesh mode.

BUG: 502159

+/*
+    SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Niccolò Venerandi <niccolo@venerandi.com>
+
+    SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-2.1-only OR LGPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-KDE-Accepted-LGPL
+*/
+
+#include "wifip2pwidget.h"
+#include "ui_wifip2p.h"
+
+#include <NetworkManagerQt/Utils>
+#include <NetworkManagerQt/WifiP2PSetting>
+
+WifiP2PWidget::WifiP2PWidget(const NetworkManager::Setting::Ptr &setting, QWidget *parent, Qt::WindowFlags f)
+    : SettingWidget(setting, parent, f)
+    , m_ui(new Ui::WifiP2PWidget)
+{
+    m_ui->setupUi(this);
+
+    // Connect for setting check
+    watchChangedSetting();
+
+    // Connect for validity check
+    connect(m_ui->peer, &KLineEdit::textChanged, this, &WifiP2PWidget::slotWidgetChanged);
+
+    KAcceleratorManager::manage(this);
+
+    if (setting) {
+        loadConfig(setting);
+    }
+}
+
+WifiP2PWidget::~WifiP2PWidget()
+{
+    delete m_ui;
+}
+
+void WifiP2PWidget::loadConfig(const NetworkManager::Setting::Ptr &setting)
+{
+    NetworkManager::WifiP2PSetting::Ptr wifiP2PSetting = setting.staticCast<NetworkManager::WifiP2PSetting>();
+
+    m_ui->peer->setText(wifiP2PSetting->peer());
+    m_wfdIEs = wifiP2PSetting->wfdIEs();
+}
+
+QVariantMap WifiP2PWidget::setting() const
+{
+    NetworkManager::WifiP2PSetting setting;
+    setting.setPeer(m_ui->peer->text());
+    setting.setWfdIEs(m_wfdIEs);
+
+    return setting.toMap();
+}
+
+bool WifiP2PWidget::isValid() const
+{
+    return NetworkManager::macAddressIsValid(m_ui->peer->text());
+}
+
+#include "moc_wifip2pwidget.cpp"
